Decision-counterfactual prior (from POLICY, applied as reasoning rule): an allocation is justified only if success, failure or non-measurability changes a concrete architecture, product or funding choice; narrative refinements and PASS-rate gains are not sufficient.

Frozen-transaction prior (governance): completing FROZEN experiments under their frozen designs preserves auditability and avoids silent post-hoc redesign; PREFREEZE work is superseded only when the scientific objective materially changes.

Prerequisite-centralization prior (general engineering/science management, not SPIDER evidence): when multiple lanes would otherwise re-derive the same substrate defect, one Runtime/Product repair dominates parallel discovery of the same absence.

Exploration/exploitation prior (general agent-research knowledge, not SPIDER evidence): once a solution family (blind-resolver calibration on frozen banks; credential-free GET-only revalidation ladders) has been mined without crossing its ceiling, marginal value shifts to orthogonal substrates or to converting the bounded result into product economics rather than another in-family variant.
